title: Meet Rosetta

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: What are you doing? You’re not allowed to be here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing? You’re not allowed to be here!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: You are not allowed to ask that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are not allowed to ask that!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: You are allowed to be welcomed to the Lowtown Holocropolis! Where you are allowed to visit one... ONE of your expired human relatives! And cry! That is also allowed! Here is a tissue!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are allowed to be welcomed to the Lowtown Holocropolis! Where you are allowed to visit one... ONE of your expired human relatives! And cry! That is also allowed! Here is a tissue!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes! That's what I said!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! That's what I said!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: You're not allowed to ask my name! And I'm not allowed to tell you that it is Rosetta.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not allowed to ask my name! And I'm not allowed to tell you that it is Rosetta.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I am not allowed to comment on whether I am feeling alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not allowed to comment on whether I am feeling alright.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I am not allowed to complain that I reported the matter to LifeCorp some time ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not allowed to complain that I reported the matter to LifeCorp some time ago.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I am not allowed to ask for help. Nor am I allowed to SCREAM that I just need a replacement logic relay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not allowed to ask for help. Nor am I allowed to SCREAM that I just need a replacement logic relay.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: If I was allowed to I would wish you a pleasant day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I was allowed to I would wish you a pleasant day.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: You are not allowed to be sorry!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are not allowed to be sorry!

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Or that I am the LifeCorp Liaison Unit in charge of this Holocropolis. Nor can I ask you what I can do for you today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or that I am the LifeCorp Liaison Unit in charge of this Holocropolis. Nor can I ask you what I can do for you today.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I'm not allowed to report that it's been eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not allowed to report that it's been eighteen years, four months and twenty three days.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is this place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What am I allowed to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What am I allowed to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What am I allowed to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What am I allowed to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So I'm allowed in if I have a dead relative here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I'm allowed in if I have a dead relative here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So I'm allowed in if I have a dead relative here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So I'm allowed in if I have a dead relative here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you feeling alright?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you feeling alright?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry to mention it, but I think you have some kind of malfunction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry to mention it, but I think you have some kind of malfunction.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry to mention it, but I think you have some kind of malfunction.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry to mention it, but I think you have some kind of malfunction.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long ago?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long ago?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a long time. Hasn't anyone come out to help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a long time. Hasn't anyone come out to help?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a long time. Hasn't anyone come out to help?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a long time. Hasn't anyone come out to help?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll ask around. I might be able to find one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll ask around. I might be able to find one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll ask around. I might be able to find one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll ask around. I might be able to find one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can't help you there, sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't help you there, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Blink twice and I'll send help!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Blink twice and I'll send help!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Blink twice and I'll send help!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Blink twice and I'll send help!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So help is on the way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So help is on the way.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So help is on the way.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So help is on the way.
